@returns The arguments the program was started with as one string, with a space between them. It is empty when there are none. A program run by `blitzcc` gets the arguments given after its file (`blitzcc game.bb -level 2`, like the original), or after `--args`.

```blitzbasic
Print "Started with: " + CommandLine$()
```
